_comment: Config for the OpenCode->Claude hooks bridge (plugins/claude-hooks-bridge.js). The plugin is the generic engine; this file declares WHICH Claude hook scripts run on which bridged event. Start conservative: only hooks that are harness-agnostic and map cleanly are wired. Claude-mechanism-specific hooks (SubagentStart injection, tool-registry enforcement keyed on Claude tool names, stdout context-injection on SessionStart) are intentionally omitted -- they have no faithful OpenCode analog.
